title: SetResponse re-export uses elided default T=serde_json::Value across ~20 methods
description:
Files:
- crate-jmap-chat-client/src/methods/mod.rs:36-39 (re-export)
- crate-jmap-chat-client/src/methods/{chat,message,space,custom_emoji,space_ban,space_invite,misc}.rs (uses)

`SetResponse` is re-exported from `jmap-types` and used pervasively:
```rust
pub use jmap_types::{ AddedItem, ChangesResponse, GetResponse, QueryChangesResponse,
                     QueryResponse, SetError, SetResponse };
```

Upstream declares it as `pub struct SetResponse<T = serde_json::Value>`. Every public method signature in this crate uses `SetResponse` (no explicit type param), e.g.:

```rust
pub async fn chat_create(...) -> Result<SetResponse, ClientError>
pub async fn message_create(...) -> Result<SetResponse, ClientError>
pub async fn space_create(...) -> Result<SetResponse, ClientError>
```

The elision means every signature is actually `SetResponse<serde_json::Value>`. Implications:

1. **The signature is dependent on upstream's default.** If `jmap-types` changes the default (e.g. to a non-`Value` placeholder, or removes the default), every consumer breaks at compile time.
2. **Migrating to typed responses is now breaking.** A future improvement where `chat_create` returns `SetResponse<jmap_chat_types::Chat>` (so `response.created["c1"]` is already typed) cannot be made additively — it changes the return type.
3. **Untyped `serde_json::Value` in `.created` forces every caller to do a second deserialize.** Today `let chat: Chat = serde_json::from_value(response.created[CALL_ID].clone())?;` is the boilerplate every caller writes after every `chat_create`. The typed `SetResponse<Chat>` would eliminate this.

Two paths:
1. **Make the elision explicit**: write `SetResponse<serde_json::Value>` everywhere. Eliminates the silent dependency on upstream's default. Cheap (search-and-replace).
2. **Adopt typed responses for `*_create` methods**: change `chat_create -> SetResponse<jmap_chat_types::Chat>`, etc. Removes a caller boilerplate per method but is a breaking change.

The typed-response migration is the better caller experience but a coordinated workspace decision (mail-client, contacts-client, etc. would want the same). Path 1 is a quick wrapper-fix for the SemVer surface only.

Workspace canonical-template note: mail-client follows the same `SetResponse` (elided) pattern. Decision should be workspace-wide, not chat-client-only — file as a design-decision bead at the workspace level if this gains traction.
close_reason: SetResponse default type param removed in 85b7dc2b (wf92.10)
